newsitem.title: FRANCE: France's Juppe orders security plan after blast.
newsitem.headline: France's Juppe orders security plan after blast.

text.p: French Prime Minister Alain Juppe told reporters an explosive device had caused a blast at a Paris train station which killed two people on Tuesday .
He said he had ordered the relaunching of an anti-terrorism security plan, which was first decreed last year after a wave of bombings by Algerian Moslem fundamentalists.
The plan, called "Vigipirate", involves police and army patrols in sensitive public areas and spot checks across the country.
The explosion occurred on the same line, and two stations away from Saint-Michel station where an explosion in July last year killed eight people and injured nearly 100.
The Interior Ministry said two people were killed and 47 injured, seven of them seriously, in Tuesday's blast below the junction of Boulevard Montparnasse and Boulevard Saint-Michel.
